business.title: What business is the content for?
business.description: e.g. 'a six-person design studio', 'a small publisher'.

audience.title: Who do you write for?
audience.description: e.g. 'small business owners planning a rebrand'.

tools.name: studio_status
tools.description: The whole studio: the pipeline by stage, everything publishing in the next 14 days (late items first) with ids, stages and owners, who has what, and what each published piece has been repurposed into. Call it first when asked what is coming, who is on what, or what a piece still needs.

tools.name: add_piece
tools.description: Save a long-form piece: title, format, stage, who writes it, publish date (YYYY-MM-DD), the search keyword and one line on its angle. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a piece is pitched or mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: update_piece
tools.description: Move a piece to another stage (idea, brief, draft, edit, design, published), hand it to someone else, or change its publish date. To push it later or earlier pass shiftDays and the studio does the date math. Call it the moment the person says a piece moved.

tools.name: repurpose_piece
tools.description: Plan what a piece spins off: a newsletter, social posts, video chapters, short videos or quote cards. One call per format; count is how many of that format the piece should have in all (three posts = count 3), and the studio dates each one after the piece publishes. Call it as soon as repurposing is asked for, before you write any of it.

tools.name: update_spinoff
tools.description: Move one of a piece's spin-offs (planned, drafted, scheduled, published), or change its date, channel or owner. To push it later or earlier pass shiftDays.

tools.name: list_pieces
tools.description: Every piece and spin-off with its stage, date and owner.

tools.name: page_update_piece
tools.description: Move a piece to another stage.

tools.name: page_repurpose_piece
tools.description: Plan what a piece spins off.

tools.name: page_update_spinoff
tools.description: Move a spin-off to another stage.
